The patient has positive patch test reactions to multiple allergens, including nickel, cobalt, and sesquiterpene lactone mix, which is consistent with allergic contact dermatitis.

The patient has a history of hand eczema and limited contact with irritants, but the severity of the eczema and the presence of other symptoms suggest that irritant contact dermatitis may also be a contributing factor.
The patient's hand eczema is severe and has a high HECSI score, which is consistent with nummular dermatitis.
The patient's hand eczema is severe and has a high HECSI score, which is consistent with dyshidrotic eczema.
The patient has a history of asthma and rhinitis, which are associated with seborrheic dermatitis.
The patient has a positive patch test reaction to nickel, which is consistent with contact allergy to nickel.
The patient has a positive patch test reaction to cobalt, which is consistent with contact allergy to cobalt.
